    - Old Bain was a fisherwoman, the first in the cove to build a ship big enough to sail round the whole island. That is her boat-hook up above the door, ash and iron.
    - They say she sailed round Veligor with a crew of her cousins and a goat. I have never decided whether the goat is true. I like to think it is.
    - Every nick is a story. That small one is where she fended off a rock in the fog. That long one is a fishing line that nearly took her overboard.
